piezas.titulo: Speaking practice: Weather, climate and experiences
texto: End of the Intermediate section (CU-TFL Intermediate / TPA T2): at this level you consolidate the ability to hold face-to-face exchanges about daily life, timetables, transport, travel, business procedures, health and weather experiences. Your skills let you link ideas with «เพราะ...จึง...», contrast them with «แต่» and express time aspects with «จะ» and «แล้ว». Great progress towards advanced narration and opinion!

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ประสบการณ์การชมพระอาทิตย์ตกริมชายหาดสร้างความทรงจำที่น่าประทับใจแก่นักเดินทาง» express?

opciones.texto: Watching the sunset over the sea leaves an unforgettable memory for the traveller.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ประสบการณ์การชมพระอาทิตย์ตกริมชายหาดสร้างความทรงจำที่น่าประทับใจแก่นักเดินทาง» from the text.

opciones.texto: The weather forecast helps you take an umbrella or raincoat when you go out.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The monsoon season brings greenery to the forests and farmland.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
